how_to_apply: The notice states that the detailed advertisement and the online application form are available on the ITBP recruitment website. Candidates can follow these steps:
Open the detailed advertisement for Constable (General Duty) under Sports Quota and read it carefully.
Open the online application form, which is available from 3 October 2026, 00:01 AM.
Fill in the required details and submit the application before 1 November 2026, 11:59 PM.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 100/- if you are a male candidate belonging to the UR, OBC or EWS category. Other categories mentioned above are exempted.
The documents required and the exact steps of the online form are not listed in the notice and are given in the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q1. What is ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment by Indo-Tibetan Border Police Force (ITBP) to fill 126 vacancies of Constable (General Duty), Group 'C' Non-Gazetted and Non-Ministerial, under the Sports Quota for meritorious sportspersons.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota Recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 126 vacancies in total, including 72 for male candidates and 54 for female candidates across 28 sports disciplines. The vacancies are tentative and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The last date is 1 November 2026 at 11:59 PM. Online applications start on 3 October 2026 at 00:01 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The educational qualification is not specified in the Employment News notice. Candidates should check the detailed advertisement on https://recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 23 years. Meritorious sportspersons get an upper age relaxation of up to 5 years, and up to 10 years for SC/ST candidates, subject to the conditions in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 100/- for male candidates in the UR, OBC and EWS categories. Females, ex-servicemen, and SC and ST candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official ITBP recruitment website, https://recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in, between 3 October 2026 and 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The selection stages are not specified in the Employment News notice. They are given in the detailed advertisement, and ITBP may change the sequence of the process.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level-3 with a pay range of Rs. 21,700 to Rs. 69,100.

faq.question: Q10. Are ex-servicemen or physically challenged candidates eligible?
faq.answer: No. As per the notice, these vacancies are not open for physically challenged persons or ex-servicemen.
